note: The 'Tear your own' beat (1:04-1:24). `use` picks the variant the film renders (the UntornDemo composition's `tear` prop overrides it): `sim` is a simulated tear of a real 1903 letter (data/samples/chouteau-1903) filmed as a live run on untorn.vercel.app; `real` is a printed page torn by hand into 6 pieces, filmed as a live run on untorn.vercel.app on 1 Nov 2026 (all 6 pieces on one page). Each variant names its frame data (written by scripts/capture/golden-data.mjs), its on-screen honesty label, and the capture frames the edit cuts on, picked from that capture's contact sheet. See video/README.md, 'Swap the real-tear beat'.

sim.label: Live run on untorn.vercel.app, waits cut. The photo: a simulated tear of a real 1903 letter, sent from an emulated phone.
sim.frameNotes: capture/golden-prod, 32 ms of page time per frame: the 'Tear your own' panel shows its QR from 32 (before that, the 'Show a QR code' button), so the edit starts at 34; 115 the hero takes the run, 140 the photo lands; 440-500 SAM 3.1's pieces lift onto the light table; 884-922 Muse's read 'emigrated' in the loupe; 1170-1235 the last pieces come home (7, 8, 9 of 10 at 1178, 1194, 1210); 1236-1296 the climax close-up ('Orleans' from 1244, the gap closes at about 1272, Muse's reason from 1292); 1366-1415 Muse types the page into the hero; 1440 on, the whole page and the transcript. The replay caught 17 single frames between two paints (an empty stage at a read's arrival; listed as `blank` in golden-frames.json): the film shows the frame before each.

real.label: Live run on untorn.vercel.app, waits cut. The photo: a page torn by hand into 6 pieces, sent from an emulated phone.
real.frameNotes: capture/golden-real (run g3sj5fmhr33xem8j on the live site, 1 Nov 2026: 6 of 6 pieces on one page, transcript with no gaps), 32 ms of page time per frame: the QR from 22; 120 the hero takes the run, 144 the photo lands; 692-700 SAM 3.1 outlines the pieces, 710-720 they lift onto the light table; 856-886 Muse reads "necessary" across a tear in the loupe; 1198-1366 the pieces come home (home = climax - 66 so the assembly runs on into the climax at the film's cues); 1366 the climax close-up, "proves" from 1378, the tear closes 1402-1416, Muse's reason from 1430; 1470 the whole page; 1506-1520 Muse types the page into the hero; 1520 on, the whole page and the transcript. phone/phone-2-check.png was re-shot afterwards on the live phone page with the same code and the same photo as JPEG (scripts/capture/phone-check.mjs): the capture's headless Chromium cannot draw HEIC, so its preview was blank; an iPhone's browser shows it.
